description: Search verified holiday rentals. Every listing shows its licence, its real town worked out from the map coordinates, and measured distances to the beach and the airport. Filter by town, dates and guests. With checkIn and checkOut, each result includes the total price of the stay (cleaning included); without dates, the lowest nightly price of the next 60 days. Call it without a place to see which destinations exist.
